description: This PHP class defines the model 'BulkLeaveEntitlementMatchingEmployeeModel' used for serializing and managing bulk leave entitlement data associated with employees. It implements interfaces for collection normalization and model construction, and provides methods to convert employee and entitlement data into an array format.

classes.name: BulkLeaveEntitlementMatchingEmployeeModel
classes.description: A model representing bulk leave entitlement data for employees, supporting serialization and array conversion.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with arrays of employees, entitlements, and an optional entitlement value.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the model data into an array suitable for serialization, associating employees with their entitlements.

methods.name: getEntitlementArrayWithEmpNumberAsKey
methods.description: Creates an associative array of entitlements keyed by employee numbers, with validation to prevent duplicates.
